exposure: Pre-eclampsia associated with intrauterine growth restriction
outcome: Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitors (p21 and p16) expression
cohort: Nulliparous women undergoing pre-labor elective caesarean section, divided into three groups: pre-eclampsia without IUGR (n=5), pre-eclampsia with IUGR (n=8), and IUGR only (n=6), compared to controls (n=20)
finding: IUGR pregnancies show evidence of premature senescence, while pre-eclampsia demonstrates cell cycle checkpoint activation indicative of cell repair and proliferation rather than senescence.
